description: Receipt split hold (IDEV-3334): the quantity an approved fuel receipt's split reserves on the supplier's advances (PARC) and purchase order lines until the receipt posts. Named {request_id}-v{version}. Written only by fuelbuddy_procurement.api.receipt_split_hold (place, release) and by the posting of the Purchase Receipt that names it; while Held, no other split and no desk receipt can take its quantity. Never deleted: a released, rejected or consumed version stays as the record of that attempt.

fields.description: The app's fuel request (fillup_request.id) whose receipt this split is for.
fields.label: Request ID

fields.description: The attempt, minted by the app: a higher version is newer. Placing a new version releases the request's live one.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Held: reserves its lines' quantity. Rejected: the split did not fit (see Refusals); holds nothing. Released: given back (see Release Reason). Consumed: posted by the Purchase Receipt below.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The only Purchase Receipt (App Op Key) that may post this hold.
fields.label: Op Key

fields.description: The split was the oldest-first pre-fill when it was placed: advances oldest first, each taking all it could, then purchase order lines oldest first.
fields.label: Oldest-first Split

fields.description: Released before it was ever placed, so that a late place of this version, or of any lower one, holds nothing.
fields.label: Tombstone

fields.description: Request ID while Held, empty otherwise. Unique: the database allows one live hold per request.
fields.label: Live Request ID

fields.description: A replay of this version must carry the same split.
fields.label: Lines Hash

fields.description: The receipt's litres: the lines add up to them.
fields.label: Total Litres

fields.description: Why the split did not fit: one entry per line at fault, plus the split's own.
fields.label: Refusals

fields.description: REPLACED: a newer version was placed. POSTING_REFUSED: ERP refused its receipt. APP_WRITE_FAILED: the app could not record the approval. REQUEST_CLOSED: the request was rejected or cancelled. ORPHAN: the daily check found no approved request for it.
fields.label: Release Reason

name: Receipt Split Hold
